register.labelZh: BRUSH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: brush against、brush by 和 brush past 可以描述人、動物或物件經過時非常接近另一物件,甚至輕輕碰到它。；BRUSH 片語動詞可以幫助你描述刷走泥、灰塵、沙、碎屑和鬆散頭髮等不同清潔動作。；brush somebody off 可以表示某人不獲理會,或在對方沒有認真聆聽的情況下被打發走。；brush up 和 brush up on 可以表示重溫一段時間沒有使用的知識或技能。
register.summaryEn: Brush against, brush by and brush past help you describe a person, animal or object moving very close to something and touching it lightly. The BRUSH family gives you several useful ways to talk about removing mud, dust, sand, crumbs and loose hair. Brush somebody off shows that a person is being ignored or dismissed without enough attention. Brush up and brush up on help you explain that you are reviewing knowledge or skills that you have not used recently.
